added.title: Director of Marketing & Corporate Communications
added.description:
Corporate Communications and Marketing Director

About Us

BlackSky
is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

BlackSky is seeking a strategic communications and marketing leader to define and execute our corporate brand, reputation and market-engagement strategy. Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing & Communications, the Director will lead a high-performing team that advances our position with key industry stakeholders and manages the company's reputation. This leader will balance engaging storytelling with brand discipline to elevate BlackSky’s narrative and maintain a consistent presence. The role requires a player/coach mindset, and you will contribute directly to shaping BlackSky’s reputation in the news and other avenues of earned media. This hybrid position is based in Herndon, Virginia, or Seattle, Washington, and is expected to travel occasionally to support BlackSky engagements globally.

This position is based either in Herndon, Virginia or Seattle, WA and will be in the office on a hybrid basis of at least two days per week.

Responsibilities

Develop and own the integrated corporate communications and marketing strategy aligned with growth, capture and investor priorities.
Define the company's brand architecture, positioning and messaging across defense, space and commercial segments.
Serve as trusted advisor to the C-suite on messaging, reputation and stakeholder engagement.
Lead executive visibility planning and execution, through speeches, keynotes, op-eds, panel preparation, and thought leadership.
Partner with Government Relations to support congressional, agency and allied-nation engagement.
Support investor, analyst and industry association communications as applicable.
Direct crisis communications planning and response.
Manage external agency resources, including a PR-focused agency, while coordinating reviews, executive stakeholder meetings and media.
Collaborate with leadership and internal subject matter experts to train/prepare spokespersons and create supporting campaign assets, not limited to briefing documents, outward-facing briefing materials and news announcements, imagery, and other creative visual assets.
Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Business, or related field
A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in corporate communications and/or B2B marketing.
Exceptional writing, editing and executive presence.
Proven crisis communications experience and sound judgment under pressure.
A quick and enthusiastic learner who is resourceful and committed to finding solutions.
A passion for the space industry and a natural grasp for technology and cultural megatrends shaping our world.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the capacity to explain and translate complex technology concepts into simple and intuitive narrative.
Exceptional attention to detail, even when managing multiple deadlines.
Proven ability to work with and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
Candidates must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous defense or aerospace technology experience, both internationally and within the U.S.
Familiarity with the defense acquisition lifecycle and customer decision-making.
Experience with account-based marketing, marketing automation, and CRM platforms.
Familiar with (U.S.) media law, AP Style and journalistic principles for newsgathering and publication.

Life At BlackSky For Full-time Benefits Eligible Employees Includes

Medical, dental, vision, disability, group term life and AD&D, voluntary life and AD&D insurance
BlackSky pays 100% of employee-only premiums for medical, dental and vision and contributes $100/month for out-of-pocket expenses!

15 days of PTO, 11 Company holidays, four Floating Holidays (pro-rated based on hire date), one day of paid volunteerism leave per year, parental leave and more
401(k) pre-tax and Roth deferral options with employer match
Flexible Spending Accounts
Employee Stock Purchase Program
Employee Assistance and Travel Assistance Programs
Employer matching donations
Professional development
Mac or PC? Your choice!
Awesome swag

The anticipated salary range for candidates in Herndon, VA and Seattle, WA is $175,000 - $200,000 per year. The final compensation package offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on specific background and education. BlackSky is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect salary ranges in other states or locations outside of Herndon, VA and Seattle, WA.

BlackSky is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

added.title: Sr. Marketing & Communications Manager, Events & Experiences
added.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101510

Position Overview

Autodesk's Events & Experiences team creates impactful experiences that strengthen relationships with customers, partners, employees, and industry leaders while advancing business objectives and elevating the Autodesk brand.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Marketing & Communications (MarCom) Manager to drive audience acquisition, engagement, and communications across Autodesk's premier events, including Autodesk University (AU), One Team Conference (OTC), TechX, and other strategic programs.

This role requires a strategic, results-driven marketer who can translate business objectives into compelling, multi-channel campaigns that drive awareness, registration, attendance, and engagement.

Working closely with the Director of Audience Acquisition & Engagement and cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will own the integrated event MarCom calendar, develop audience-focused communications, and ensure coordinated, timely campaign execution.

This position reports to the Director of Audience Acquisition & Engagement.

Important:
This is a Marketing & Communications role focused on audience acquisition, content, communications, and campaign execution—not Event Operations, Production, or Event Management.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives and event goals
Translate business goals into integrated marketing and communications strategies that drive measurable outcomes
Drive audience acquisition and engagement throughout the attendee journey, from awareness and registration through post-event follow-up
Manage multi-channel campaigns across email, web, social, paid media, and internal and partner channels

Communications & Audience Engagement

Create compelling, audience-specific messaging and content for customers, partners, prospects, executives, and employees
Develop targeted email campaigns using audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation
Ensure communications are clear, engaging, and aligned with Autodesk's brand voice

Project & Stakeholder Management

Own the end-to-end event MarCom calendar, including campaign plans, content milestones, approvals, dependencies, and channel timelines
Manage multiple projects and collaborate with Corporate Comms, Brand, Social, Field Marketing, Sales, Marketing Ops, and event stakeholders
Anticipate risks, resolve roadblocks, and drive alignment to ensure campaigns launch on time

Performance & Optimization

Monitor registration, conversion, attendance, engagement, and channel performance
Use data and audience insights to optimize campaigns and recommend improvements
Share results, learnings, and recommendations with stakeholders and leadership

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of experience in marketing, audience acquisition, or campaign management
8+ years of professional experience writing, editing, and developing marketing and communications content for diverse audiences, including email campaigns, executive communications, presentations, websites, and event marketing assets (i.e. blogs, website, ppt toolkits etc)
Experience with Marketo and Salesforce
Experience developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, web, social, and paid media
Experience managing audience-segmented email campaigns, including personalization and localization for global audiences
Demonstrated experience managing marketing calendars, campaign roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables for large-scale programs
Experience developing campaign frameworks, playbooks, templates, and standardized processes
Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute marketing programs and campaigns
Experience using campaign analytics, registration data, and performance metrics to optimize marketing outcomes
Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM platforms, and campaign analytics tools
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading marketing and communications programs for large-scale customer conferences, employee events, or flagship corporate programs
Strong understanding of audience acquisition, customer journey marketing, and event lifecycle communications
Strong organizational, project management, and stakeholder management skills
Collaborative, adaptable, detail-oriented, and results-driven, with the ability to manage competing priorities
Experience communicating with senior executives and navigating complex cross-functional environments

Learn More

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

added.title: Regional Marketing Lead- Southeast
added.description:
Job Description

At Pentair, you will work alongside passionate problem-solvers who are committed to the future of our planet. We put our mission into practice, helping the world sustainably move, improve, and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential water filtration to industrial water management to pool products and more, our 9,000 global employees serve customers in more than 150 countries, working to help create a better world for people and the planet through smart, sustainable water solutions.

We have an opportunity for a Regional Marketing Lead to support the Southeast region. You will be responsible for developing and executing regional marketing activities that drive customer engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue across Dealer, Distributor, and Retail channels. Acting as the voice of the region and a marketing partner to sales, this individual will support the development of integrated marketing plans, bringing forward campaigns and investments needed to drive pipeline, dealer engagement, and growth. This role reports to the Senior Marketing Manager- East/West Division.

Travel/Location:

This role requires someone to be located near the Charlotte, NC area. This position will be remote when not traveling and requires someone to have the ability to travel up to 40%.

You Will

Partner closely with regional sales leadership to align marketing activities with territory goals, target accounts, and growth priorities.
Support the development and execution of regional go-to-market and omni-channel marketing plans, translating national campaigns, product launches, and business priorities into localized programs that reflect market dynamics and customer needs.
Monitor regional market trends, competitive activity, customer feedback, and growth opportunities, providing recommendations to strengthen market engagement and business performance.
Lead the planning and execution of regional events, including trade shows, dealer events, training, ride-alongs, and customer experiences.
Develop and deliver account-targeted events and engagement programs in partnership with sales to generate pipeline and accelerate key opportunities.
Manage event execution from planning through post-event follow-up, including logistics, budgets, communications, and performance measurement.
Collaborate with Brand, Content, Digital, and Product Marketing teams to adapt messaging, content, and creative assets for regional relevance and effectiveness.
Deploy and optimize regional merchandising, sales enablement tools, marketing collateral, and branch support initiatives to strengthen distributor, dealer, and local market activation.
Execute regional education, onboarding, and training programs, including Pentair University initiatives, dealer enablement, product training, and customer development activities.
Develop and execute account-based marketing programs for priority dealers and customer segments, leveraging personalized engagement tactics and regional insights.
Support the adoption and effectiveness of loyalty, rebate, dealer incentive, and co-op marketing programs to drive engagement, retention, and share of wallet.
Plan and execute integrated demand generation programs across events, digital channels, dealer marketing activities, and local partnerships to support pipeline growth.
Align regional marketing activities with territory plans, sales objectives, and priority customer segments to maximize business impact and resource effectiveness.
Manage assigned marketing investments and program budgets while providing recommendations to optimize spending and improve performance.
Track, analyze, and report on marketing performance through Salesforce CRM on all activities including pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, lead quality, and conversion metrics.

Key Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, or related field required.
5-7 years of marketing experience with a strong emphasis on field marketing, regional marketing, demand generation, customer marketing, or channel marketing.
Ability to travel up to 40%.
Demonstrated success contributing to the development and execution of localized marketing strategies that drive customer engagement, pipeline growth, and revenue outcomes.
Proven experience partnering closely with sales teams to develop territory-based marketing plans and support customer acquisition, retention, and growth.
Experience leading integrated, multi-channel marketing programs including events, account-based marketing, local demand generation, and customer enablement initiatives.
Experience working within dealer, distributor, channel marketing, or two-step distribution (B2B2C) business models preferred.
Strong analytical experience utilizing Voice of Customer insights, market intelligence, sales data, and competitive analysis to inform marketing decisions.
Strong strategic and tactical planning with the ability to connect regional marketing initiatives to business objectives and revenue outcomes.
Strong business acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and make data-driven recommendations.
Skilled at influencing without authority and building alignment across sales, marketing, and operational stakeholders.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with the ability to engage audiences ranging from field sales teams to senior leadership.
Proven ability to lead initiatives, drive accountability, and deliver results in a highly collaborative environment.
Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Demonstrated ownership mentality with a proactive, solution-oriented approach and continuous improvement mindset.
Data-driven decision maker with experience evaluating marketing performance, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and ROI.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce CRM, and marketing technology platforms.
Ability to mentor, coach, and develop others through influence and leadership.
Must reside near the Charlotte, NC area.

Compensation

For this full-time position working at this location, the anticipated annualized base pay range will be from $71000 - $131800 / year. At Pentair, it is not typical for an individual to be hired near the bottom or top of the pay range. Pentair considers various factors in determining actual compensation for this position at the expected location. Actual compensation will be commensurate with demonstrable level of experience and training, pertinent education including licensure and certifications, work location, and other relevant business or organizational needs. This position may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as, annual incentive bonus.

Benefits

As a Pentair employee, you would enjoy a wide array of benefit options to help keep you and your family healthy and protected, health benefits, a generous 401(k), employee stock purchase program, disability benefits, life insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, parental leave, caregiver leave, tuition reimbursement, plus paid time off and wellness programs to encourage a healthy work/life balance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, United States of America, Raynham, Massachusetts, United States of America, Warsaw, Indiana, United States of America, West Chester, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Description

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

We are searching for the best talent for a Marketing Manager, Global Growth Marketing
to join our VELYS™ Power team ideally located in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
, however Raynham, MA, Warsaw, IN, and West Chester, PA may also be considered .

The Marketing Manager, Global Growth Marketing
will be responsible for downstream marketing and commercialization strategies that maximize portfolio value, customer adoption, and profitable growth. The role leads business and marketing planning, with a primary focus on lifecycle management and portfolio optimization to improve efficiency, strengthen profitability, simplify the portfolio, and maximize value across the product lifecycle. This position also supports the commercialization and ongoing management of strategically sourced technologies external innovation partnerships.

The Marketing Manager, Global Growth Marketing
will report to the Sr. Marketing Manager, Global Growth Marketing, VELYS™ Power.

Responsibilities Include

Lead downstream marketing strategies, annual marketing plans, and commercial programs that drive portfolio adoption, utilization, revenue growth, and profitability.
Own lifecycle management and portfolio optimization initiatives, including product transitions, portfolio simplification, margin improvement, and end-of-life planning.
Assess market research, customer insights, competitive dynamics, portfolio performance, and financial results to prioritize investments and improve business performance.
Lead commercialization and launch execution for new products, portfolio enhancements, and strategically sourced technologies developed with external manufacturing and innovation partners.
Partner with regional and local marketing and sales teams to develop customer conversion, demand generation, pricing, and market execution strategies.
Develop positioning, value propositions, multichannel marketing programs, sales enablement tools, communications, and commercial education that support customer acquisition, retention, and utilization.
Collaborate across Sales, Global Strategic Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Healthcare Compliance, and external partners to ensure commercial readiness, supply continuity, and lifecycle execution.
Manage assigned budgets and track forecasts, key performance indicators, portfolio risks, and growth opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to business leadership.
Support customer-facing commercial activities, including customer meetings, field visits, industry events, product demonstrations, laboratory programs, and procedure or surgical evaluations, to gather insights, enable adoption, strengthen relationships, and support market development.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in marketing, product management, commercialization, business development, or related field.
Experience in downstream marketing, product commercialization, lifecycle management, portfolio optimization, or capital equipment marketing.
Strong commercial, analytical, and financial acumen, including experience with business planning, forecasting, pricing, project management, budgets, and performance tracking.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives and drive tactical execution across a matrixed organization.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Medical device, orthopedic, capital equipment, or healthcare industry experience preferred.
Ability to work in operating room and cadaver lab environments and travel up to 25%, including domestic and international travel, to support customer-facing activities, laboratory programs, industry events, procedure or surgery observation.

On October 14, 2025, Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.

It is anticipated following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by Orthopaedics employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Orthopaedics at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

The Customer Marketing & Omnichannel Manager is responsible for translating Sun-Maid’s brand and business priorities and customer strategies into customer-specific marketing and omnichannel plans that drive profitable growth.

Serving as a key marketing partner to the Sales and broker teams, this role leads the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing, retail media, and e-commerce programs. The Manager connects brand strategy, customer objectives, shopper insights, promotional activity, and commercial priorities to create integrated programs across in-store and digital touchpoints.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in CPG customer or shopper marketing with meaningful experience in e-commerce, Amazon, retail media, and the digital shelf, as well as the ability to adapt strategies across critical retail channels, including Mass, Grocery, Club, and E-Commerce. This highly cross-functional role partners closely with Brand Marketing, Sales, broker teams, Insights, Finance, and external agency partners to move programs from strategy and brief through execution, optimization, and performance measurement.

Requirements

Customer & Shopper Marketing

Serve as a primary Brand Marketing partner to Sales and broker teams, working closely with them to understand, capture, and translate customer strategies, priorities, and opportunities into actionable customer marketing plans.
Build strong working relationships with Sales and broker partners to maintain a current understanding of customer objectives, retailer priorities, merchandising plans, innovation opportunities, and evolving business needs.
Translate Sun-Maid brand and business priorities and customer strategies into differentiated customer marketing plans for key retail partners.
Develop annual and ongoing customer activation plans in partnership with Sales and cross-functional teams.
Use customer, shopper, category, and competitive insights to identify growth opportunities and inform activation strategies.
Partner with Insights to incorporate relevant consumer, shopper, category, and customer learning into customer-specific strategies and plans.
Ensure customer programs address clearly defined business objectives, including Buy Rate, trial, repeat, conversion, brand relevance, and successful innovation launches.
Translate national brand campaigns and innovation platforms into relevant customer-specific programs.
Develop compelling customer activation stories and materials to support Sales in retailer meetings, line reviews, and joint business planning.

Activation & Program Execution

Lead customer-specific programs from approved strategy and brief through execution, optimization, and post-program analysis.
Develop clear, insight-based briefs outlining the business opportunity, shopper objective, audience, activation strategy, KPIs, and deliverables.
Lead external shopper, retail media, creative, e-commerce, and other agency partners in the development and execution of customer programs.
Coordinate customer activation calendars, timelines, deliverables, budgets, approvals, and cross-functional dependencies.
Ensure programs connect relevant in-store and digital touchpoints, including merchandising, retailer.com, search, retail media, social commerce, and consumer promotions.
Evaluate customer and Sales requests for strategic fit, business impact, and alignment with established priorities.
Independently manage day-to-day program decisions while escalating significant investment decisions, strategic changes, or competing priorities as appropriate.

Customer & Channel Strategy

Develop customer strategies that reflect the unique shopper, merchandising, and activation dynamics of priority channels, including Mass, Grocery, Club, and E-Commerce.
Partner closely with Sales to support Club customers, including Costco and Sam’s Club, to identify opportunities to protect and grow the core business and support innovation, including customer-specific and limited-time offerings.
Translate brand and Innovation priorities into customer-specific activation strategies that reflect each retailer’s business model, shopper expectations, merchandising approach, and path to purchase.

Promotional Integration & Activation

Partner with Sales and Insights to understand customer promotional plans, performance, and opportunities, incorporating relevant learnings into customer activation strategies.
Align shopper marketing, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer-facing activation with priority promotional and merchandising windows.
Leverage Insights-led promotional analysis and historical performance to inform activation timing, tactics, and investment recommendations.
Identify opportunities to amplify priority promotions through integrated in-store and digital activation.
Manage consumer-facing promotional programs, including coupons and other shopper incentives, as appropriate within the broader customer plan.
Incorporate promotional and activation learnings into post-program reviews and future customer marketing plans.

Omnichannel & E-Commerce

Lead the integration of e-commerce and digital commerce into customer marketing plans, connecting in-store, retailer.com, and pure-play e-commerce experiences.
Bring strong omnichannel expertise across e-commerce and digital commerce, including Amazon and key retailer platforms, while connecting digital capabilities to broader customer and channel strategies.
Partner with Sales, Brand Marketing, and external partners to improve the discoverability, relevance, and conversion of Sun-Maid products online.
Support Amazon strategy across product content, retail readiness, search, digital merchandising, media, and promotions.
Identify opportunities to strengthen Sun-Maid's digital shelf across Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, Kroger.com, and other priority platforms.
Help optimize product detail pages, search relevance, enhanced content, ratings and reviews, online assortment, and conversion.
Ensure e-commerce best practices are applied to both existing products and new product launches.

Retail Media

Lead the development of customer retail media strategies aligned to brand, shopper, and commercial objectives.
Partner with Sales, agencies, and retail media networks to develop integrated retailer media plans.
Support planning across platforms such as Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Roundel, Kroger Precision Marketing, and other priority networks.
Evaluate agency and retailer recommendations across paid search, onsite and offsite media, display, social commerce, connected TV, and other relevant formats.
Ensure campaigns have clear objectives, audiences, KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans.
Connect retail media investment to the broader customer strategy rather than managing it as an isolated media tactic.
Use performance data to recommend optimizations to targeting, tactics, and investment.

Measurement & Optimization

Partner with Insights, Sales, Finance, and agency partners to establish objectives and KPIs for customer marketing, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer activation programs.
Leverage Insights-led analyses, customer data, and agency reporting to evaluate program performance and identify business implications.
Evaluate programs using relevant measures such as sales, Buy Rate, trial and repeat, new-to-brand, incremental sales, ROAS, conversion, digital penetration, and promotional lift.
Understand and appropriately distinguish between attributed sales and incremental business impact.
Translate results into clear, actionable recommendations for future customer activation and investment.
Capture post-program learnings and apply them consistently to future planning and optimization.

Budget & Agency Management

Manage assigned customer marketing, shopper activation, retail media, e-commerce, and consumer promotion budgets.
Maintain accurate budget forecasts and manage program spending in partnership with Finance and agency teams.
Ensure investments align with strategic priorities and expected business impact.
Recommend opportunities to increase, reduce, or reallocate investment based on performance and business needs.
Manage agency partners through clear briefs, scopes, timelines, deliverables, and performance expectations.
Hold partners accountable for strategic quality, execution, timing, budget, and results.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build strong partnerships across Brand Marketing, Sales, Insights, Finance, Innovation, Operations, and external partners.
Work closely with Sales to understand, capture, and apply customer strategy, acting as a key connector between customer objectives, brand strategy, shopper needs, and activation execution.
Bring the customer and shopper perspective into broader brand, innovation, and business planning.
Partner with Brand and Innovation leads to translate campaigns, positioning, and innovation priorities into effective customer activation.
Partner with the Associate Brand Manager on customer-facing assets, innovation launches, and shared executional priorities as appropriate.
Proactively communicate performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy while elevating the decisions that require senior leadership direction.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
5+ years of experience in customer marketing, shopper marketing, omnichannel marketing, e-commerce, trade marketing, or a related CPG discipline.
Experience developing and executing customer-specific marketing plans for major retailers.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Sales and/or broker teams to translate customer priorities into actionable marketing strategies.
Strong understanding of the relationship between Brand Marketing, Sales, shopper marketing, promotions, e-commerce, and retail media.
Demonstrated experience developing customer marketing strategies across multiple retail channels, with experience in e-commerce/Amazon and/or Club strongly preferred.

Guide paid media

Align paid campaigns with product launches, messaging, and pipeline goals.
Review results—including spend, lead quality, cost per opportunity, and pipeline contribution—and recommend improvements.
Use AI-assisted tools to support analysis, ad testing, and reporting, with human review before campaign or budget changes.

Build practical workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency, and content reuse.

Customers and sales teams can clearly explain what MOTOR’s priority products do and why they matter.

Content priorities reflect customer needs, product plans, and business goals.

added.description:
About C4 Therapeutics:

C4 Therapeutics (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to delivering on the promise of targeted protein degradation science to create a new generation of medicines that transforms patients’ lives. C4T is progressing targeted oncology programs through clinical studies and leveraging its TORPEDO® platform to efficiently design and optimize small-molecule medicines to address difficult-to-treat diseases. C4T’s degrader medicines are designed to harness the body’s natural protein recycling system to rapidly degrade disease-causing proteins, offering the potential to overcome drug resistance, drug undruggable targets and improve patient outcomes. For more information, please visit www.c4therapeutics.com .

Job Summary

The Associate Director, Marketing will own the pre-launch brand foundation for cemsidomide: market definition, positioning, and early launch planning in multiple myeloma. You will work hands-on, translating clinical data into a clear strategic story and partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Market Access, and Corporate Communications. As cemsidomide is investigational, all external activity will be non-promotional and compliant with pre-approval guidelines.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone equally comfortable designing a marketing campaign and running a physician advisory board to get in on the ground level of our commercial build out at C4T. Your skills and passion for this space will allow you to have a front row seat to see what it looks like to build out a commercial function at a small life sciences company as one of our first dedicated commercial hires.

Your Role

Messaging Development

Lead development of disease-state and messaging for multiple myeloma, translating clinical data into clear, compliant narratives.
Run message testing with hematologist-oncologists, community oncologists, and other customers; refine messages as data mature.
Build and maintain the core messaging platform and ensure consistent use across venues and audiences.
Take materials through Medical/Legal/Regulatory review with a clear grasp of pre-approval compliance.

Agency of Record (AOR) Selection and Onboarding

Lead the search for C4T's first marketing AOR: define requirements, build the RFP, run pitches, and recommend a partner.
Onboard the selected agency: brief them on the disease area, science, and compliance expectations; set up ways of working, review cadence, and scopes of work.
Manage the agency day to day, including budgets, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

Advisory Boards

Plan and run advisory boards with KOLs and community physicians, in partnership with Medical Affairs, to gather customer insights.
Set objectives, design discussion guides, select participants, and manage logistics with vendors.
Synthesize findings into clear recommendations and share them with cross-functional and senior leadership.

Competitive Intelligence

Track the MM landscape, including next-generation IKZF1/3 degraders, BCMA- and GPRC5D-directed bispecifics, CAR-T, and anti-CD38 regimens.
Lead congress coverage and competitive readouts at key meetings.
Deliver regular competitive intelligence updates and assess implications for Cemsidomide's development and messaging.

Congress Booth Presence

Own C4T's corporate and disease-awareness booth presence at major hematology and oncology congresses.
Lead booth concept, design, and content with the AOR, medical affairs and exhibit vendors, ensuring all content is non-promotional and approved.
Manage booth logistics, staffing, budget, and post-congress performance reviews.

Your Background

Required:

A Bachelor's Degree in life sciences, business, or a related field with a minimum of eight years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology space, including at least five years in product or brand marketing, including oncology marketing experience.
Hands-on experience turning corporate and departmental strategy into marketing execution with a strong sense of independence.
Working knowledge of pre-approval compliance and the Medical/Legal/Regulatory review process.
Ability to read and communicate clinical trial data with accuracy and confidence.

Preferred

MBA or advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MS).
Hematologic malignancies experience strong preferred, including multiple myeloma experience, ideally on a launch or pre-launch team.
Experience at a small or emerging biotech building processes from scratch.
Familiarity with the healthcare professional community

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

As Customer Marketing Manager, you’ll own the programs that turn Rippling’s happiest customers into our most powerful growth engine. You’ll build and run Wavemakers, our customer advocacy program, recruiting and engaging a community of advocates with meaningful incentives. You’ll also own our customer reference program, building a roster of referenceable customers and making sure Sales has what they need to close deals, with an eye toward scaling the program as our product suite and international footprint grow.

added.description:
Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, HCP and Access Marketing to lead the end to end customer segment strategies through tactical execution for HCPs and access stakeholders as the company prepares for the portential approval and launch of vidofludimus calcium in relapsing MS. This is a builder role for a marketer who has done this before: someone who has led/supported global brand strategy through an MS launch , understands how positioning, messaging and channel strategy need to flex across the US market, especially targeted at HCP and access (e.g., population based/financial decision makers, payer, practice manager) and can build/lead a high performing team of marketers focused on these stakeholders. This role sits at the center of launch, working in lockstep with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Market Access, Patient Services, Commercial Operations and other functions to maximize the near- and long-term value of vidofludimus calcium across its lifecycle while supporting the development of brand strategy that reflects both the science and the realities of how the therapy will actually reach patients.

You will join us at a pivotal point pre Phase 3 data readout, when the organization is actively planning key commercial activities such as positioning, disease education and building the commercial function. The ideal candidate combines high strategic leadership with hands-on execution/data analysis, collaboration across varied internal and external stakeholders, ability to inspire and build a team to deliver results with lean resourcing.

Responsibilities

Own HCP and organized customer/access segment strategy. Develop strategies aligned with brand strategy and a core narrative that can be adapted across US and international markets.
Build a differentiated brand story. Translate clinical and mechanism-of-action data into messaging that is relevant to physicians.
Shape the launch playbook. Apply lessons from prior global MS launches to sequencing, market prioritization and pre-launch disease education.
Lead omnichannel and digital execution. Own end-to-end delivery across web, social and non-personal promotion, using disruptive digital and technology solutions to increase impact.
Use insights and analytics to drive decisions. Support global market research. Partner with forecasting and analytics on launch scenarios, segmentation, targeting and KPIs.
Drive market access pull-through. Partner with Market Access on an integrated plan across payers, population-based decision makers and practice managers. Own the strategy and resources for pull-through.
Integrate cross-functionally for launch readiness. Work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Regulatory and Legal/Compliance so that strategy, messaging and channel plans are ready before approval.
Manage budget and investment. Build and manage the HCP and access marketing budget with marketing peers, Access, Finance and the VP of Marketing.
Lead agency partners and scalable operations. Onboard and manage creative, media, research and digital agencies. Help build marketing processes and governance that scale from pre-launch to commercial launch.
Advise commercial leadership. Serve as a strategic advisor on market dynamics and opportunities.

Qualifications & Education

Bachelor's degree required. MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive marketing experience in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals, with significant experience in brand and global marketing and access leadership roles.
Direct experience leading HCP and market access customer strategy and marketing through the launch of a therapy in multiple sclerosis.
Proven track record with end to end strategy through execution across digital and field promotional channels. Ability to showcase use of AI, data, disruptive technologies to increase impact of marketing campaigns a strong differentiator.
Experience managing global or multi-customer segment positioning, balancing core brand consistency with customer segment needs and opportunities.
Strong experience managing external agency partners across creative, media, digital, and market research.
Demonstrated ability to translate clinical and scientific data into clear, differentiated brand positioning and messaging.
Experience partnering closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Patient Advocacy functions on integrated launch strategy.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25–40% of the time, including internationally
Comfort operating in a lean, fast-moving, pre-commercial biotech environment
Experience launching a therapy with a novel mechanism of action or first-in-class positioning
Existing relationships within the global MS clinical, scientific, patient advocacy community, practice manager, financial / population based decision maker (and other access stakeholders)
Fluency with digital and omnichannel channel approaches, and demonstrates growth mindset to adapt proven marketing approaches with disruptive technologies and innovations

added.title: Marketing & Brand Design Associate
added.description:
Two Brands. Real Ownership. Room to Create.

Full-Time | Washington, DC | In-Person | $55,000–$75,000 + Overtime Eligible

We're looking for a creative, independent marketer with strong visual design skills
to help shape and execute marketing for two growing businesses.  

Hylton-Rodic Law (HRL)
is a boutique intellectual property law firm serving innovators in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and the life sciences.  

EPIARX Diagnostics
is a private pathology practice serving families, healthcare professionals, attorneys, and other partners seeking answers through specialized medical services.  

The organizations share ownership, leadership, and an office in Washington, DC, but serve very different audiences with distinct brands and marketing goals.  

One opportunity to help both brands grow.

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive a list of posts to make. You'll work closely with leadership and business development to understand our audiences, identify marketing opportunities, develop creative concepts, and turn ideas into finished work.  

We want someone who can think independently, design thoughtfully, write clearly, and take ownership from concept through execution.

You don't need to know intellectual property law or pathology. You do need the curiosity and initiative to learn.  

What You'll Do

Own and maintain marketing calendars
across both organizations, planning and executing social media, blogs, newsletters, email campaigns, and other recurring content.  
Create original digital and physical marketing materials
, including graphics, brochures, presentations, conference materials, advertisements, mailers, branded collateral, and other content.  
Help develop and evolve our brands
, including creative concepts, new service logos, visual identities, messaging, templates, and campaign ideas.  
Write and translate complex subjects
into clear, engaging content tailored to distinct professional and consumer audiences.  
Maintain and improve our websites
, including content, layout, imagery, landing pages, and digital marketing initiatives.  
Support CRM and email marketing
, including campaign development, audience segmentation, and marketing workflows.  
Partner with business development and leadership
to identify opportunities, propose ideas, and execute initiatives that support organizational growth.  
Manage projects independently
, coordinating timelines, feedback, approvals, and publication without constant oversight.  

You'll receive direction, context, and feedback—but we'll also expect you to bring ideas, exercise judgment, and move work forward.  

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an emerging professional with strong creative instincts, sound judgment, and the maturity to own their work.

You should bring:  

Strong visual design ability
, including original creative concepts, typography, composition, layout, and brand consistency.  
Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills
, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.  
Experience creating digital and/or physical marketing materials
, including content, collateral, campaigns, or brand assets.  
Experience with website content management
and familiarity with CRM, email marketing, or related digital marketing platforms.  
Demonstrated project ownership
, from understanding an objective and developing an idea through execution and delivery.  
Strong organization, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving skills.

Proficiency with creative software and modern marketing tools
, including the ability to leverage AI thoughtfully to improve research, workflows, and production efficiency.  
A bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated experience in marketing, graphic design, visual communication, advertising, or a related field.  

Especially valuable:
Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Squarespace, GoHighLevel or comparable CRM platforms, SEO, brand identity development, photography, and print production.  

We welcome early-career applicants with strong portfolios, meaningful internships, freelance experience, or demonstrated ownership of creative projects.  

You don't need to be an expert in everything.
We care about your creative judgment, initiative, ability to learn, and the quality of your work.  

Compensation & Benefits

$55,000–$75,000 annually
, depending on qualifications and experience. This is a full-time, in-person, non-exempt position eligible for overtime.  

Benefits include health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; commuter benefits; paid time off; mental-health days; birthday leave; Sunshine Fridays; professional-development support; and an extended year-end holiday break.  

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and a tailored cover letter
addressing the following:  
1. Show us how you think creatively.

Explore Hylton-Rodic Law and EPIARX Diagnostics. Identify one marketing or branding opportunity for each organization
and tell us what you would do with it.  

Think beyond simply suggesting another social media post. What would you create, improve, or approach differently? Who would it reach, and why would it matter?  

We're interested in your ideas, creative instincts, and ability to connect marketing with business goals—not a perfect understanding of either industry.  

2. Show us something you've created.

Tell us about one creative or marketing project you're particularly proud of. What was the objective? What did you personally contribute? What decisions did you make, and what made the result successful?  

Selected candidates may be invited to submit additional materials
, including a portfolio or work samples, college transcript, short video response, or brief creative exercise.  

We encourage applicants to be thoughtful, specific, and original. We want to see how you think—not just where you've worked.

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

About Hybrid

Recently acquired by EAB, Hybrid is a globally recognized and award-winning agency that operates as a full-service marketing partner for the education sector, connecting universities with students worldwide. Powered by unrivaled insight, advanced technology, and AI-driven enrollment strategies, our integrated marketing solutions help education brands grow. We tackle the sector’s toughest challenges head-on and continuously strive for excellence, staying on the pulse of emerging trends. When you join our division of EAB, you become part of a tight-knit, ambitious, supportive, and rapidly growing team. You’ll work on big ideas with talented colleagues who respect your input, challenge your thinking and push you to do your best work. Visit our website to learn more about our story

The Role In Brief

Paid Media Executive, Hybrid

Hybrid is seeking a motivated, analytical, and results-driven Paid Media Executive to join our growing Digital team. In this role, you'll execute and optimize paid media campaigns for higher education clients around the world, helping institutions connect with prospective students through innovative, data-driven digital marketing strategies.

As a Paid Media Executive, you'll manage campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other digital advertising platforms while partnering with Account Managers, Digital Strategists, and clients to deliver measurable performance. You'll analyze campaign data, uncover actionable insights, and continuously optimize campaigns to maximize results across multiple channels.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their expertise in paid search, paid social, and emerging media platforms while working on global campaigns with significant budgets in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment.

This hire may be based in Philadelphia, PA, Richmond, VA, or Washington, D.C.

Primary Responsibilities

The Paid Media Executive is responsible for planning, launching, optimizing, and reporting on digital advertising campaigns that drive measurable results for Hybrid's higher education partners.

Campaign Management

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic platforms.
Execute campaign optimizations to improve performance and maximize return on advertising spend.
Monitor campaign pacing, budgets, and performance to ensure client objectives are achieved.
Support international campaigns across emerging media platforms as business needs evolve.

Performance Analysis & Optimization

Track campaign KPIs and analyze performance across multiple digital channels.
Develop insightful campaign reports that clearly communicate results and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
Identify performance trends, optimization opportunities, and emerging audience behaviors.
Utilize data to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and overall client outcomes.

Client Success & Collaboration

Build a strong understanding of each client's goals, enrollment objectives, and marketing strategy.
Partner closely with Account Managers and Digital leadership to develop integrated media strategies.
Collaborate with platform partners including Google and Meta to leverage best practices and new capabilities.
Contribute ideas that improve campaign performance, innovation, and client experience.

Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate campaign documentation, reporting, and time management.
Ensure projects are completed on schedule while managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Stay current on industry trends, platform updates, and emerging digital advertising technologies.
Continue developing expertise across new advertising channels and international media platforms.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
1-3+ years of experience managing paid digital media campaigns, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
Experience working with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify actionable insights.
Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or similar reporting tools.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to continuously learn and improve.

Ideal Qualifications

Experience managing paid Search, Social, and Programmatic advertising campaigns.
Familiarity with campaign tracking, attribution, and digital marketing analytics.
Experience working with large advertising budgets across multiple clients.
Passion for digital marketing, emerging advertising technologies, and performance optimization.
Ability to think strategically while executing campaigns with precision.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally with client services and creative teams.
Experience working within an agency environment is preferred.

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $60,000 - $70,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

Partner with Growth Marketing to ensure content supports SEO, AI-driven search discovery (AEO), and organic audience growth.
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Creative teams to ensure content is accurate, differentiated, engaging, and aligned with Fleetio's broader messaging.
Balance long-term editorial initiatives with the agility to capitalize on timely industry trends and business opportunities.

Drive demand generation and business impact

Partner with Revenue Marketing to develop content that attracts, engages, and converts prospective customers across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments.
Create content that supports integrated campaigns, lead generation, account-based marketing, and sales enablement initiatives.
Develop distribution and amplification strategies that maximize the reach, engagement, and business impact of content investments.
Measure and optimize content performance across engagement, organic visibility, lead generation, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution.

Scale content production and innovation

Own the content development process from ideation and research through writing, editing, stakeholder reviews, and publication.
Establish efficient editorial workflows that maintain exceptional quality while enabling consistent, timely content production.
Leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate research, ideation, repurposing, and production without compromising originality, accuracy, or editorial quality.
Build strong relationships with internal subject matter experts and business leaders to uncover insights and translate their expertise into compelling content.

Your Experience

7+ years of experience developing and producing high-quality content in B2B SaaS, with a strong emphasis on thought leadership and content marketing.
Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to create compelling long-form and short-form content.
Proven experience developing original research, industry reports, executive thought leadership, and other high-impact content assets.
Strong understanding of how content supports demand generation, SEO, brand awareness, and pipeline growth.
Experience building editorial strategies and content calendars that align with business priorities and integrated marketing campaigns.
Demonstrated ability to transform complex topics, data, and research into clear, engaging narratives for business audiences.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives and deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate across Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders.
Highly self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable taking ownership of content initiatives from concept through execution.

added.title: Sr. Manager / Assoc. Director, Marketing Analytics & Intelligence
added.description:
Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director, Marketing Analytics & Intelligence to help build the next generation of our agency’s measurement and intelligence capabilities.

This role requires three core strengths: advanced marketing measurement expertise, the ability to translate analytics into business decisions, and proven leadership in building analytics capabilities and developing talent. The ideal candidate can connect media investment, consumer behavior, marketing performance, and business outcomes, then turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for clients and agency leadership.
This role goes beyond campaign reporting. You’ll shape measurement strategy, lead advanced analytics engagements, advise senior clients, manage and develop analytics talent, lead cross-functional initiatives, and advance our AI-enabled analytics and intelligence capabilities.

What You’ll Own

Advanced Measurement & Intelligence
Lead advanced measurement across MMM, MTA, incrementality, experimentation, attribution, and media effectiveness
Evaluate methodologies, data quality, and analytical outputs to ensure rigor
Integrate media, consumer, and business data to uncover insights and growth opportunities

Business Translation & Client Leadership
Translate complex analytics into actionable media, marketing, and business decisions
Serve as a senior analytics advisor to clients and agency leadership
Lead cross-functional initiatives across Media, Strategy, Account, Creative, and Technology

Capability & Team Building
Manage, coach, and develop analytics talent
Build scalable measurement frameworks, tools, workflows, and standards
Advance AI-enabled analytics and marketing intelligence capabilities, applying emerging technologies to research, forecasting, reporting, and automation

What We’re Looking For

6–10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, media analytics, measurement, BI, or related disciplines
Demonstrated experience with advanced measurement, including MMM, MTA, incrementality, experimentation, attribution and/or media effectiveness
Proven ability to translate complex analytics into marketing, media, and business decisions
Strong executive-level storytelling and experience advising clients and senior stakeholders
Experience building measurement frameworks and leading cross-functional initiatives
Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, and developing analytics talent

Preferred Background

Ideal candidates will come from marketing measurement, analytics, consulting, or media organizations with advanced measurement capabilities, or from sophisticated in-house marketing science or analytics teams.
Experience with some of the following is valuable:
Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio
GA4 and Adobe Analytics
CRM, sales, and first-party data
Identity resolution products such as Acxiom
Nielsen, MRI-Simmons, YouGov, GWI, Numerator, or similar platforms
Competitive intelligence platforms such as MediaRadar
AI-enabled analytics and workflow automation
Python or R is preferred, but not required. We’re looking first and foremost for someone who can lead analytical thinking, ask the right questions, challenge methodologies, develop people, and turn data into decisions.

WHAT’S IT LIKE WORKING AT INTERTREND:

● Work with fun, loving yet hard-working individuals! Our biggest values center on dialogue, cross-functional collaboration, curiosity, and respect.

● We’re a multi-cultural agency focused on the Asian American community, so if you’re passionate about the latest Asian American trends, culture, and media, openly share it!
● Want to give back to the community? Intertrend is not just about making a profit; we are also here to make a difference! Join us on our various volunteering programs and opportunities. Be an agent of change!
● Like to branch out to different tasks to learn and grow? We always have projects on hand seeking volunteers; you can seek out challenges that’ll help shape you!

We recognize that every candidate brings a different combination of experience and expertise. As a result, compensation is determined individually, taking into account job-related skills, relevant experience, education, training, and other factors that contribute to success in the role.

added.description:
About The Company

Gas South is a leading provider of natural gas services committed to delivering reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy solutions to residential and commercial customers. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, innovation, and community engagement, Gas South has established itself as a trusted name in the energy sector. The company emphasizes operational excellence, technological advancement, and a customer-centric approach to ensure that clients receive the highest quality service while promoting environmental responsibility. Gas South's dedication to community involvement is reflected in its philanthropic initiatives and partnerships with various non-profit organizations, aiming to make a positive impact beyond business operations.

About The Role

The Marketing Analyst I at Gas South is a dynamic position designed for analytical thinkers who thrive on solving complex business challenges through data-driven insights. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to contribute to strategic decision-making processes by analyzing customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, and operational data. As part of a collaborative team, you will work closely with stakeholders across multiple departments, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Operations, to develop actionable insights that support business growth and efficiency. The role is ideal for individuals eager to develop technical skills in SQL, Python, and business intelligence tools, while also honing their ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, Business Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Prior internship, co-op, academic projects, or professional experience involving data analysis or business analytics is highly preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, along with exposure to analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms, is essential. A foundational understanding of data validation, data transformation, and structured problem-solving concepts is required. Candidates should demonstrate curiosity about customer and business analytics, possess strong organizational and time management skills, and have the ability to communicate insights effectively. Exposure to analytical techniques like regression analysis, forecasting, A/B testing, and hypothesis testing is advantageous.

Responsibilities

Analyze customer behavior, sales, marketing, and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that support strategic growth initiatives.
Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer acquisition, retention, profitability, and lifecycle performance to inform business strategies.
Aggregate, clean, transform, and prepare large datasets from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, CRM systems, and internal applications, to facilitate reporting and analysis.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that effectively communicate complex insights to stakeholders.
Conduct ad hoc analyses, customer segmentation studies, campaign evaluations, and A/B testing to support ongoing marketing and sales initiatives.
Apply advanced analytical techniques to evaluate marketing effectiveness, sales performance, and customer engagement metrics.
Support forecasting, planning, and performance measurement efforts by identifying key trends and providing actionable insights.
Validate data inputs, outputs, calculations, and assumptions to ensure accuracy and reliability of analytical outputs.
Document methodologies, data definitions, and business rules to promote transparency and facilitate future analysis.
Communicate findings, insights, and recommendations clearly and effectively to cross-functional teams and leadership.
Collaborate with various departments to understand business needs and develop tailored data-driven solutions.
Continuously seek opportunities to enhance analytical capabilities, streamline processes, and expand technical skills.

Benefits

Full-time employees at Gas South enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, financial security, and personal growth. Benefits include full medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with employer-paid life and disability insurance. The company offers annual employer contributions of up to 12.5% to employees' 401(k) plans, encouraging long-term financial planning. Remote work options are available based on business needs, providing flexibility and work-life balance. Employees are also eligible for an annual performance incentive, which is a percentage of the annual benchmark aligned with their position level. Gas South recognizes the importance of rest and renewal, offering a paid four-week sabbatical every five years. Community engagement is encouraged through volunteer opportunities, and educational support of up to $5,250 per year helps employees pursue professional development and personal enrichment.

Equal Opportunity

Gas South is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. The company does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Gas South’s policies ensure fair treatment in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, and termination. The company values the unique perspectives and contributions of all employees and is dedicated to creating a respectful and equitable environment for everyone.

added.description:
Company Description

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.

Job Description

The Marketing Operations Manager works cross-functionally to project manage the review process for advertising and promotional materials for approved drug and/or device products. In addition, the Manager is responsible for identifying and leading specific Marketing Operations function(s) and/or special projects, required to achieve the designated brand(s) objectives. The Manager act as a Marketing Operations subject matter expert for the PRC review process and is responsible for ensuring the process efficiency involving Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance teams, while conforming with company policies and procedures.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead and manage cross-functional promotional review (PRC) meetings. Build and manage meeting agendas as a partner to Marketing and facilitate meetings while memorializing PRC reviewer comments and job requirements. The Manager is also responsible for monitoring and optimizing the promotional review process of assigned brands. Manage all meeting logistics, including scheduling, on designated brands, working independently on all aspects of both offline and live reviews to help achieve the brand key milestones and objectives.
Manage key function(s) of the review process for assigned brand(s). The Manager will become a trusted partner responsible for performing other Marketing Operations function(s) (i.e. Editorial Review, Print Production, Electronic System Administration, etc.) in support of the assigned brand(s). Works closely with Brand Marketing, the PRC Committee, Compliance, and the rest of Marketing Operations, to proactively identify and resolve issues and ensure reviews are efficiently completed throughout various stages of the process. The Manager will utilize system and reporting to effectively communicate and actively manage jobs with Brand/Project originators.
Enable best practices and SOP conformance. Incorporate best practices and insights to help develop high-quality jobs. Ensure jobs adhere to company policies and FDA guidance. The Manager also ensures that all SOP requirements are met. Provides guidance and training as required to all PRC participants.
Interface with Editorial, Production and Regulatory team members to assist with system execution of submission processes. The Manager is knowledgeable in each area to help with timely submissions and execution to ensure potential issues are resolved for overall achievement of deadlines (Proofing requirements, Regulatory Affairs return of jobs, 2253 submission to OPDP, etc.).
Lead Special Projects for the assigned Brand(s)/Team. As the promotional review subject matter expert, the Manager is responsible for partnering with the assigned commercial team to identify and lead special projects to help optimize the efficiency of the promotional review process and materials management of the assigned brand(s) (i.e. Claims Library, Template development, etc.). Required to work in collaboration with Marketing Operations, BTS and respective Brand team(s). Accountable for owning and monitoring the performance of the materials review process and identify areas of opportunities and innovation to driver further efficiencies.

Qualifications

Experience working in a pharmaceutical or healthcare advertising environment.
Familiarity with promotional review systems such as Veeva strongly preferred.
Moderate to Advanced Microsoft Skills (Outlook, Excel, Word, PPT)
Experience with editing helpful
Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills
Strong project management skills
Knowledge of FDA regulations for pharmaceutical advertising and promotion
Strong presentation and meeting facilitation skills
Bachelor’s Degree and minimum of 5 years of experience

This range may be modified in the future.
