added.title: AI Product Manager, Growth Marketing
added.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

By day 90:
Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.
Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.
Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

By the end of year one:
Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.
Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.
Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.

Skills You'll Need To Bring

Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.
Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.
Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.
Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.
High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $191,000 - $225,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

added.description:
About HYBE Americas

HYBE AMERICAS, a subsidiary of HYBE Corp., is a leading global entertainment and media company at the intersection of music, film, television, technology, brands, culture and social good. HYBE AMERICAS drives innovation across the entertainment landscape through its diverse portfolio, including Blue Highway Records, the publishing company Big Machine Music and Quality Control Music in the U.S., and HYBE’s labels in Latin America and the U.S. Hispanic market. The company represents a powerhouse roster of global artists spanning multiple genres and cultures. With headquarters in Los Angeles, HYBE AMERICAS creates synergistic opportunities for artists, businesses, and brands through its integrated approach to talent development, content creation, and technological innovation that transcends industries.

At HYBE, we believe in the power of music and foster a culture built on Passion, Autonomy, and Trust.

Position Overview

HYBE Americas is looking for a Social Media & Community Manager who thrives at the intersection of music, fandom, and internet culture. As a key member of our Digital Marketing team, you will oversee the social strategy, platform growth, and digital narrative that connects our artists to a global audience. You will be responsible for managing daily community engagement and executing high-impact social campaigns that resonate with fans worldwide.

This is a full-time hybrid role based in our Santa Monica office, with in-person collaboration 3
days per week and remote work 2
days per week. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to the greater Los Angeles area at their own expense prior to their start date — we are not offering relocation assistance for this role, though it may be considered on a case-by-case basis for select candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily posts: Schedule and post content across all social media channels
Develop and execute social media strategies to boost engagement and expand our reach
Create compelling content that is relevant to our global audience and maintains brand voice. Taking good photos, film / edit videos, and design graphics is a plus.
Engage with fans and collaborate with content creators to foster a thriving online community
Stay up to date on current trends to ensure content is fresh, relevant, and impactful (creative individual with lots of ideas, the better)
Collect daily metrics on all platforms
Collaborate across various teams to coordinate content creation and ideation
Monitor sentiment and report on fan engagement, adjusting strategies as needed
Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs)—link clicks, likes, and other metrics

Qualifications

Being obsessively online. Proven experience in managing social media platforms and tools: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X accounts. Weverse experience/user is a plus.
Deep understanding of social media best practices and platform operations, understanding metrics of success (engagement, acquisition, etc)
Ability to think on your feet to handle real-time situations and adapt strategies promptly.
Thrives in the dynamic rhythm of the global entertainment space, with a flexible mindset regarding working hours around key releases, time-sensitive projects, live moments, and real-time fan connection.
Previous working experience in the music or entertainment industry is a strong plus.
Excellent grammar and copywriting abilities
Great organizational skills; ability to balance multiple priorities
Basic editing and design skills (Canva, CapCut), willing to learn

Account Coordinator
Scale Marketing | Chicago, IL | Hybrid Schedule (3 Days in Office, 2 Days Remote)

About Scale Marketing
Scale Marketing is a full-service media strategy and data analytics firm that helps businesses make smarter marketing investments and achieve measurable results. We combine media planning and buying, data analytics, creative services, and ongoing optimization to help our clients reach their business goals.

Our team brings together diverse business and media expertise, using customer data and historical media performance to develop smarter strategies and continually improve results. We believe our success starts with how we treat our clients and each other, and we're looking for curious, motivated professionals who want to grow with us.

About the Role
The Account Coordinator is an essential member of Scale Marketing's Client Services team, supporting Account Managers and Strategists with account planning, media execution, and campaign management. This role provides hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of a client's marketing program, from onboarding and research to media placement, campaign monitoring, and billing reconciliation.

As a bridge between client services, media buying, vendors, and finance, you'll help keep projects organized, campaigns on track, and deliverables accurate. You'll work across multiple media channels, including TV, radio, and digital, while developing an understanding of how media strategy, execution, and performance measurement work together.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, analytical, and proactive professional who enjoys managing details, solving problems, and learning how a full-service media agency operates. You'll also have opportunities to leverage AI tools and automation to improve workflows and support planning activities.

Key Responsibilities
Account Management & Coordination

Support Account Managers and Strategists with day-to-day account planning, project coordination, and media fulfillment.

Assist with client onboarding, including distributing agency-of-record (AOR) letters to media partners, coordinating vendor and client credit applications, and organizing historical media schedules.

Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and communicating progress.

Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to keep campaign workflows moving efficiently.

Media Planning & Research

Conduct market, competitive, and audience research using tools such as Media Radar, Scarborough, Claude, and other planning resources.

Assist with vendor research and media planning activities across television, radio, and digital campaigns.

Help develop client presentation decks, strategy overviews, and supporting materials, incorporating AI tools and automation where appropriate.

Organize research and planning information to help Account Managers and Strategists make informed recommendations.

Campaign Execution & Vendor Coordination

Manage digital campaign insertion orders (IOs) and maintain accurate records of budget changes and campaign optimizations.

Coordinate creative asset submissions and communicate creative updates to media partners.

Confirm that media placements are running as ordered and obtain vendor contract confirmations.

Review client airchecks and other campaign documentation for accuracy.

Respond to vendor questions during campaign reconciliation and escalate larger issues or decisions to Account Managers and the media buying team.

Billing & Reconciliation

Partner with Finance to support accurate monthly media billing and reconciliation.

Compare vendor invoices against client flowcharts, media schedules, and approved placements.

Investigate billing discrepancies and work with media vendors to identify and resolve issues.

Maintain organized records to support accurate reporting and account management.

Process Improvement & Team Support

Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve organization, and use technology to work more efficiently.

Take ownership of assigned projects while remaining flexible to support changing team priorities.

Contribute to a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment focused on delivering excellent client service.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, journalism, or a related field.

Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records across multiple accounts and campaigns.

Analytical thinking, sound judgment, and a willingness to ask questions, learn, and apply feedback.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional approach to client and vendor interactions.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and familiarity with Google Workspace tools, including Gmail, Sheets, and Docs.

Technologically savvy, resourceful, and interested in learning how AI tools and automation can improve research, planning, and everyday workflows.

A proactive, self-directed approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently while contributing to a team.

An eagerness to understand client businesses, media operations, and the inner workings of a growing agency.

What We Value in Our People
Curiosity:
We ask questions, seek insights, and continuously learn.

Honesty and Integrity:
We act with transparency and do what is right.

Respect:
We value our colleagues, our clients, and the processes that help us succeed.

Diversity and Inclusion:
We welcome different perspectives and experiences.

Teamwork Without Ego:
We pitch in wherever needed and work together to get the job done.

Client Ownership:
We treat our clients' businesses as if they were our own.

Benefits & Perks
Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance with generous employer contributions.

Ongoing education, training, and professional development opportunities.

Casual, open-office environment with a collaborative team culture.

Company-sponsored events and team-building experiences.

Exposure to a wide range of media channels, client industries, and marketing strategies.

Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career as the company expands.

Work Location
This is a hybrid position based in downtown Chicago, IL
, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week and remotely two days per week.

Ready to Grow Your Career in Media?
If you're organized, curious, comfortable working with data and details, and excited to learn how marketing strategy comes to life, the Account Coordinator role at Scale Marketing offers an opportunity to build a strong foundation in media planning, campaign execution, and client services.

Health Insurance- paid for by Scale Marketing
Dental and Vision insurance

unlimited PTO
holidays- 13 paid holidays

added.title: Sr. Marketing Data Analyst
added.description:
The Role

Pilot is hiring a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.

Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.

This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.

Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.

Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities

Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement
Define the marketing data model: the sources, metrics, and models the work depends on. Build them in dbt where you can, and partner with our analytics engineer on ingestion and the heavier platform work
Build reporting that marketers can run on their own for campaign and channel performance
Partner with marketing leadership in their planning and budget cycles, and take on work outside marketing when the business needs it

About You

Even if you don’t have experience with the specific technologies in our stack, we’d love to talk to you!

5+ years in analytics, including owning a business domain and the stakeholder relationships in it
Deep marketing analytics experience: channel performance across paid and organic, the funnel from lead through closed-won, and the unit economics on top of it
Has built or replaced an attribution model, and can explain where it breaks down
Experience designing and reading out incrementality tests, whether geo, holdout, or comparable, including the statistical work in Python or R
Designs the comparisons and controls a finding needs, and states plainly what the data does and does not support
Strong SQL, and builds reporting in Looker or a comparable BI tool that non-analysts use on their own. Comfortable building and extending models in dbt, or able to pick it up quickly
Works directly with executives, including reframing a request that will not answer the underlying question

Working Style

Values diversity and fosters inclusion on a team with a wide range of identities and experiences
Partners with the teams they support on what the right question is, rather than taking the request as given
Drives to find new tools and ways of working, and spreads them to uplevel the team and the partners they work with
Takes pride in end-to-end ownership. Cares that the numbers are trusted and used, with a point of view about where the domain should go

Nice-to-Haves

Media mix modeling or other top-down measurement experience
Marketo and Marketo Measure, or comparable marketing automation and attribution tools
Salesforce, including campaign influence reporting
Ad platform APIs, PartnerStack, GA, or other spend and engagement sources
Brand or offline measurement experience
ABM account funnel work
Production dbt experience
B2B SaaS with both sales-led and self-serve motions
Fintech, accounting software, or professional services background

About Pilot

Pilot launched in 2017 to bring the back office into the modern era. Pilot provides small businesses with dedicated finance experts - which Pilot hires as full-time, U.S.-based employees - who learn the ins-and-outs of their business. Pilot integrates directly with the billing, banking, expense, and payroll systems customers already use. With a special blend of custom software and expert bookkeepers, Pilot delivers accurate, consistent bookkeeping and financial management and tax services that give entrepreneurs the freedom to focus on their business.

Pilot has over 3,000 customers and has raised over $170 million in financing from Sequoia, Index Ventures, Stripe, Bezos Expeditions, and Whale Rock. Our investors also include a long list of world-class entrepreneurs, including Patrick and John Collison, Drew Houston, and Diane Greene. Our most recent funding round doubled our valuation to $1.2 billion – Meet Fintech’s Newest Unicorn.

Why Pilot?

We invest in our employees’ development and happiness because our employees are the keys to our success and ensuring happy customers
The opportunity to join a seasoned founding team that has led companies through two prior successful startups and acquisitions (by Oracle and Dropbox).
Flexible vacation/time-off policy
All federal holidays are observed
Competitive benefits package including additional wellness benefits
Parental leave for birthing or non-birthing parents – 100% pay for 12 weeks
401(k) plan

The base pay range target for the role seniority described in this job description is $126,000 - $170,000 in San Francisco, CA. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition to cash pay, full-time regular positions are eligible for equity, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time or temporary positions.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. added.description:
About Element451

At Element451, we're building the AI platform that moves every student forward. Our platform takes action across the entire student journey, from prospect to success, so colleges and universities can deliver better enrollment and student outcomes.

We have two product lines, Element AI CRM and the Bolt Agent Platform, and a team of 120+ people around the globe. We're backed by a $175M investment from PSG to scale our mission.

THE ROLE

As our Brand & Marketing Designer, you'll own how Element451 looks and feels everywhere our brand shows up. You'll steward our brand design system, bring our AI story to life through clear and memorable visuals, and give every team the tools to stay on brand. You'll be a creative partner to marketing, product, sales, and leadership, and you'll direct the outside partners who extend our team.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a designer who cares as much about systems as craft.

What You'll Own

Brand & Identity

Own and evolve the Element451 brand design system, and set the quality bar for everything external-facing
Build templates, tools, and AI skills that help teams across the company create on-brand work on their own
Partner with our product team to create a visual product hierarchy that carries across all of our assets

Web & Digital

Own the design of our website, social channels, email, and other digital properties
Serve as the in-house design partner to our web development agency
Design landing pages and paid creative for campaigns, gated content, and product launches

Product Marketing & Sales Enablement

Partner with product marketing to bring launches to life through product visuals, launch creative, and feature pages
Turn complex AI and product concepts into clear diagrams, product shots, and visual stories
Own the visual design of our sales deck and sales collateral

Events

Own the visual identity of Engage, our flagship conference, and the events under the Engage umbrella
Design booth environments, print, and swag for industry conferences

Video & Motion

-Build and maintain a motion design system that keeps our brand consistent in every video
Create motion graphics, animated product screens, and short-form social video
Partner with video production teams on graphics packages from concept through final cut

Required

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

5 to 10 years of brand or marketing design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology
A portfolio that shows range, craft, and systems thinking
Experience building brand systems and templates that scale across channels and teams
Experience contributing to a rebrand or brand refresh
Ability to turn complex technical ideas into clear visuals
Hands-on motion design and short-form video editing skills
Experience working with developers or web agencies to ship polished pages. You don't need to code.
Experience managing outside creative partners
Comfort with AI-assisted design workflows, and good judgment about where AI helps and where it doesn't
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities without lowering the bar
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with stakeholders at every level

Nice to Have

Higher education experience
Experience with HubSpot and common CMS platforms
Experience with Notion
Lottie, Jitter, or Rive for lightweight animation
Frame.io or similar video review tools

TOOLS YOU'LL USE

Design: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, and Canva
Motion and video: After Effects and Premiere Pro
Presentations: PowerPoint and Google Slides
AI: design tools such as Claude, Adobe Firefly, or Midjourney

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

Element451 looks cohesive and premium at every touchpoint
Teams across the company create on-brand work on their own, using the systems you build
Production moves faster as reusable systems replace one-off design
Our AI story is easier to understand through clear visuals and motion

A brand or identity system you built or extended, and the thinking behind it
B2B marketing work across web, campaigns, sales materials, and software
Complex ideas made clear through diagrams, product visuals, or motion
Motion graphics or short-form video

How a project moved from brief to delivery, and the results it drove where you can share them

added.description:
At Sony Music Publishing (“SMP”)
, we believe every voice matters. We are the #1 global music publisher, advancing the artistry of the world’s greatest songwriters and composers for over 25 years. We keep songwriters at the forefront of everything we do, and design our suite of services to amplify opportunities, build connections, and defend their rights. Our roster benefits from an international team committed to providing support at every career stage. From classic catalogues to contemporary hitmakers, history is always being written. We are a part of the Sony family of global companies. Learn more about SMP at https://www.sonymusicpub.com/en.

Why join Sony Music Group?

Here at Sony Music Group, we are shaping what’s next in a way that creates impact. Forging powerful new ideas at the heart of music, technology, and culture that entertain and move people.

This is your opportunity. Part of a global community, united by individual passion, rising to that challenge every day. Adapting at pace and supporting one another, inspired to influence the future. For the benefit of you, our people; our creators, our business, and wider society too.

Be a part of an organization that is creator first. Committed to fueling excellence and always imagining more, while fostering a supportive culture, one where we elevate each other and act responsibly.

added.title: Email Marketing Manager
added.description:
About Inner Balance
Inner Balance is a women's health company building technology-enabled solutions to improve access, experience, and outcomes in hormone health. We combine digital infrastructure, product innovation, and data-driven decision-making to create a better experience for women. Our product lines include Oestra (compounded HRT), Libida (PT-141/oxytocin sublingual tablet), BodyMatched (compounded face cream), and NAD+/Peptides.
Position Overview
Inner Balance is hiring a CRM Manager to build, launch, and maintain our email and CRM program in Klaviyo. You will work directly under our Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, turning her lifecycle strategy and testing roadmap into live campaigns, flows, and segments across all four product lines.
This is a hands-on execution role. Most of your week will be spent inside Klaviyo: building flows, scheduling campaigns, setting up A/B tests, maintaining segments, and keeping the account clean and well-organized. You will also pull performance reports, flag issues early, and help connect Klaviyo results to our MD30 multi-touch attribution model (BigQuery/Looker).
The ideal candidate is a fast, detail-oriented Klaviyo builder who ships accurately and on schedule, takes ownership of quality, and wants to grow toward lifecycle strategy over time.
Key Responsibilities
Campaign & Flow Execution in Klaviyo
Build, QA, and deploy email campaigns and automated flows (welcome, browse/cart/checkout abandonment, onboarding, post-purchase, replenishment, win-back) for Oestra, Libida, BodyMatched, and NAD+/Peptides.
Manage the weekly campaign calendar: build sends, schedule them, and make sure everything goes out on time and correctly.
Lay out emails using existing brand guidelines and Klaviyo templates; prepare clear briefs for the design team when custom creative is needed.
Set up flow logic, including conditional splits, trigger filters, time delays, and dynamic content, from specs provided by the Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager.
Run thorough QA on every send: links, rendering across devices and clients, personalization tags, UTMs, and audience targeting.

Segmentation & Account Management
Build and maintain segments and lists that reflect each product's customer journey, including subscription and one-time purchase paths.
Keep the Klaviyo account organized: naming conventions, tags, folders, archived flows, and documentation of what's live.
Monitor list health and deliverability (bounce rates, spam complaints, unsubscribes, sender reputation) and run regular suppression and sunset processes.
Troubleshoot integration and event-tracking issues, and coordinate with engineering when custom events or data feeds need fixing.

Testing & Reporting
Set up and launch A/B tests in Klaviyo (subject lines, send times, content, flow structure) according to the testing roadmap.
Track tests through to completion and document results in a shared test log.
Pull weekly and monthly performance reports from Klaviyo, and help reconcile them against MD30 attribution in Looker.
Flag performance drops, anomalies, or data discrepancies quickly, with a first look at the likely cause.

Compliance & Quality
Make sure every email and flow follows Inner Balance's compliance rules for prescription and compounded products (e.g., no unapproved treatment or cure claims, no FDA-approval language, product-specific restrictions).
Route content through the required review steps before launch.

Qualifications
Required
3+ years of hands-on experience in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing.
Strong, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including building flows, campaigns, segments, A/B tests, and reports. Please be ready to walk us through flows you've built.
Comfort with Klaviyo flow logic: trigger and profile filters, conditional splits, time delays, and dynamic content/personalization.
Ability to build a clean, on-brand email from templates and brand guidelines without a designer.
Working knowledge of deliverability best practices, list hygiene, and suppression management.
Strong attention to detail and a disciplined QA process.
Comfort with data: you can pull reports, read the numbers, and spot when something looks off.
Ability to manage multiple sends and deadlines at once with little supervision.

Preferred
Experience at an ecommerce, DTC, or consumer subscription business (e.g., Shopify, Recharge, or similar integrations with Klaviyo).
Experience with Klaviyo SMS.
Basic HTML/CSS for email.
Familiarity with BigQuery, Looker, or multi-touch attribution concepts.
Experience in health tech, digital health, or another regulated consumer category.
Klaviyo certification(s).

Ideal Candidate Profile
Lives in Klaviyo and can turn a strategy brief into a working flow quickly and accurately.
Treats QA as non-negotiable and catches errors before customers do.
Keeps the account tidy and documented, so anyone can see what's live and why.
Asks good questions, raises problems early, and suggests fixes instead of waiting to be told.
Is curious about why a test won or lost, not just whether it did.
Does well in a fast-moving, lean team where speed and accuracy both matter.
Wants to grow toward lifecycle strategy by learning from a senior channel owner.

Why Join Inner Balance
Get hands-on ownership of a Klaviyo program across four distinct product lines.
Learn directly from a senior lifecycle leader, with a clear path toward strategy and channel ownership.
See your work tied to real revenue through our in-house multi-touch attribution model.
Join a mission-driven team expanding access to hormone health and longevity medicine for women.

Compensation & Benefits
Competitive Compensation

Competitive base salary aligned with CRM/email marketing roles.

Health & Wellness

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance options.
Access to Inner Balance products and services.

Flexibility

Remote-first work environment.
Flexible schedule designed to support productivity and work-life balance.

Paid Time Off

Generous paid time off (PTO) and company holidays.

Professional Growth

Hands-on mentorship from a senior lifecycle marketer.
Room to grow your scope as the program and the company scale.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

As an Account Coordinator, Paid Media your primary function will be to provide vital production support for your account team. Day-to-day responsibilities include but are not limited to running and formatting performance reports, implementing account tasks and optimizations, building and uploading campaigns, and participating in and taking notes during internal syncs, client meetings, and presentations.

Account Coordinators will become responsible for 2-3 accounts and will learn DEPT®’s best practices for Paid Search Engine Marketing while gaining the foundational skills necessary to progress into more advanced roles that will expand on the breadth and depth of knowledge.

PROFICIENCY EXPECTATIONS

We expect Account Coordinators to develop a solid foundation of Paid Media analytical and technical expertise and be proficient in the following:

Proficiency in Excel/Sheets:

Demonstrate proficiency in using essential spreadsheet functions and formulas including, but not limited to:

sorting
filters
vlookup
concatenate
pivot tables
text to columns
conditional formatting

Demonstrate an understanding of how to take advantage of these functions and formulas when performing tasks (ex: ad customization uses concatenation and length formulas) with limited oversight needed. Accuracy is critical, and Associates will need to QA their work to ensure accurate data is being relayed to the rest of the team and clients.

Proficiency in Paid Media:

Ability to navigate through the UIs to:

Pull reports at various levels (campaign, keyword, audience, placement, device, etc.) along with the desired columns/metrics and understand the data/results.
Implement tasks via the Google UI, Editor, and other necessary channel-specific platforms
Upload & edit campaigns, targeting methods, ads, keywords, placements, negatives and other standard account management tasks within the UI
Create and edit campaigns, ads, and audiences in Facebook
Understanding of DMUS’s SEM methodology
Various metrics and how to calculate them, as well as their relationship to each other (ex: CPC, CTR, CVR, etc)
High-level understanding of the different levers to pull to hit target goals
Attend search-specific training led internally or by channel partners to continue education

Experience across Google - search, display and/or app campaigns
Experience with a combination of these campaign types: UAC (universal app campaigns), ACi (app campaign install), Google app campaigns, GDN campaigns (Google Display Network), performance max, discovery campaigns
Experience with A/B testing

GROWTH EXPECTATIONS

Over time in the role, we expect Associates to be responsible for learning and mastering higher-level concepts as outlined below:

Report write-ups –Able to identify performance trends, understand the metrics, explain why certain things happened in the past week, and develop write-ups with clear explanations.
Bid adjustments – Able to understand different bidding methodologies (smart bidding vs manual) and the strategy behind the bid adjustments.
Daily performance monitoring – Understand what to look at within the platforms daily to know when an action is needed based on performance fluctuations and trends. Understands how to leverage Qontrol to identify where accounts need attention and conduct a deeper investigation to solve execution problems.
Budget pacing - Able to update, monitor, and communicate budget pacing performance to the broader team and flag any pacing areas above/below 15% variation.
Campaign builds – Able to develop suggestions on the best method to build out a campaign, overall theme, keywords (search), parameters, settings, ads, etc.
Pixels – Able to create/pull/QA pixels, tracking, remarketing, and list creation.
Able to delegate production tasks to nearshore or other internal team members where appropriate.

Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
401K plan, plus matching
PTO
Paid Company Holidays
Parental Leave

added.title: Director of Marketing
added.description:
About the job

The Role

LettrLabs is disrupting a $30B industry by uniting AI with tangible marketing. When a storm hits, our platform geo-locates to zip code, activates direct mail campaigns in minutes, and tracks every conversion back to digital. The result: 5x return on conversions and 3x year-on-year growth for our customers.

LettrLabs is hiring its first Marketing Leader. We have built a platform that makes direct mail as automated, measurable, and scalable as digital advertising, and we have proven it works across industries. The core product is working. Now we need a leader who can build the demand engine and lead the team that scales it.

You will own marketing end-to-end: demand generation, lifecycle, field events, and budget allocation. But your center of gravity is the pipeline. You will manage a team of three, set the direction, and be the person who holds the strategy together so every dollar and every program ties back to revenue. Brand-first or Content-first backgrounds are not the right fit for this role. This leader will sit onsite at our newly opened headquarters in the westside of LA.

Why Join Us

You’ll be LettrLabs’ first marketing leader at a company with real product-market fit and accelerating revenue. You’ll take on full ownership of the department from day one.
AI augmented direct mail is surging as purely digital CACs climb.
You'll own marketing end-to-end: demand generation, lifecycle, field events, and budget allocation, and most importantly pipeline. You'll manage a team of three, set the direction, and be the person who holds the strategy together so every dollar and every program ties back to revenue.

What You Will Own

Own LettrLabs' end-to-end marketing strategy. Demand generation, ABM, lifecycle, and field events with deep knowledge in how to drive pipeline and growth.
Manage and allocate the marketing budget across paid, trade shows, and demand programs, with full accountability for ROI.
Build and scale the ABM motion for PE-backed home services accounts. We serve large, multi-million dollar targets that require dedicated, account-specific campaigns.
Lead and develop a team of three direct reports: growth/demand, field events, and lifecycle marketing.
Define the framework for how LettrLabs understands marketing ROI. Own the reporting that makes CAC, pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and payback period all visible.
Partner with Sales to improve lead quality, funnel conversion rates, and pipeline efficiency across both self-service and enterprise motions.
Set the lifecycle strategy and provide direction for a growing function. You'll influence and optimize the programs they build and run.
Scope and manage Product Marketing needs through sprint-based contractors when the work is burning; you determine when it's necessary and who does it.
Lead go-to-market execution for new product launches, integrations, and vertical expansions.

What Success Looks Like

Marketing sourced leads grow by 50% or more in the next 2 quarters.
CAC, ROAS, and payback period are tracked, improving, and visible to leadership — you built the attribution to prove it.
The ABM motion for enterprise home services accounts is defined, running, and generating pipeline.
A team that operates with clear direction, non-overlapping focus areas.

What You Bring

8–10 years in B2B SaaS or technology marketing, with deep specialization in demand generation, growth marketing, or performance marketing and an understanding of targeting PE backed companies.
Proven, measurable track record of building pipeline and driving revenue impact — you can cite CAC, ROAS, or pipeline contribution numbers from prior roles, not just program names.
Experience with both self-service/PLG and sales-led enterprise motions — you understand how to run different growth plays in parallel.
Lifecycle and growth marketing fluency. enough to set strategy, direct an IC, and know when the programs are working.
Experience building or running ABM programs targeting high-value accounts, specifically large, complex B2B buyers.
Hands-on experience with paid acquisition across search and social — you've managed budgets and optimized campaigns directly, not just directed agencies.
Experience owning a marketing budget with accountability for how it's allocated and what it returns.
HubSpot proficiency and familiarity with modern marketing and analytics stack (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, or equivalent).
Experience hiring and managing a lean in-house team alongside an agency or contractor network.
Startup and agency experience. You know what great looks like and how to get there!

Nice to Haves

Experience marketing to home services, e-commerce, or other high-volume SMB and enterprise B2B audiences.
Experience with PE backed companies
Background building or scaling a category, not just competing within one.
Familiarity with direct mail as a performance marketing channel.
Experience at a Series A–C company as the first or only marketing leader.

What does our Enterprise Analyst Program offer? 

KeyBank’s Enterprise Analyst Program is a multi-week training program. For those still in college, the program facilitates the transition from college to a full-time career at Key. The program provides opportunities to learn about Key’s business and strategic pillars, learn about Key’s industry-leading employee benefits, engage in exciting networking events with Analysts across various teams, hear from members of the Executive Leadership Team, and receive relevant training ahead of starting in a full-time role.

At the conclusion of the multi-week training program, Analysts will enter their Line of Business and begin working with their respective teams within a rotational program within a specific segment or full-time role. Continued development beyond the program is provided through mentorship opportunities with teammates across various levels of the organization that will provide an environment for shared learning and advice, encourage professional development, and assist in the development of career aspirations and goals.

About The Job

The Rotational Analyst will be actively engaging with the Enterprise Marketing Analytics team, gaining hands-on experience by working on various projects across diverse marketing channels. This rotation aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the different facets of marketing analytics, allowing the analyst to develop a well-rounded skill set and valuable insights from each channel.

Under direct supervision, the rotational analyst is primarily responsible for supporting the formulation of hypotheses, translation of data, design/measurement of experiments and generation of insights to inform business decisions by using various data mining techniques. The rotational analyst uses data to perform basic diagnostic analyses and assists the team’s diagnostic projects to provide answers to questions such as “Why did it happen?” and “What action can I take?”. Through the use of reporting and execution of ad hoc requests by pulling data and creating basic analysis and the inspection and control of testing procedures, the rotational Analytics Associate identifies trends and outliers. Success criteria include: timely and effective handling of data or analytics requests assigned by manager; providing input into basic business or analytical challenges faced by the team; building functional knowledge in analytical programming languages, data literacy, developing communication skills, business acumen, and critical thinking; and establishing relationships with peers and broader team.

Identify common data errors and their impact
Provide reoccurring reporting and ad hoc requests
Employ basic best practices for evaluating large data
Answer key business questions through exploration and discovery
Create simple analysis to support the production of insights into relevant business questions under general direction / supervision
Find patterns or anomalies by building out visualizations and PowerPoint presentations
Execute basic diagnostics testing under supervision (e.g. performance testing, assumption verification and impacts of limitations)
Tests, under supervision, suitability / sufficiency for approach (e.g. representativeness)
Provide input with addressing basic business/analytical problems and challenges

Data Literacy

Understanding of:
Data wrangling including information documentation and importing data from different formats
Descriptive statistics, random variables, common distributions, outliers

Ability to consume, query, explore, and evaluate big data; can leverage this skill to inform business questions

Navigation, shortcuts, use and share spreadsheet documents

Python//SAS/SQL:
Perform IDE walk-through; shortcuts

Use functions such as classes, variables, lists, and classes
Program files, modules, and libraries

Able to perform basic diagnostics testing
Understanding of:
Foundational statistical / measurement concepts, methods, and techniques
Basic uses, scope, features, benefits, and risks of available modeling methods)

Partnering / Influencing: Limited business partner interaction – work typically assigned by manager; Developing relationship building ability and interpersonal skills; Engage and interact mostly with immediate team and peers; Developing influencing skills

Position Overview

The Jewish Federation of Greater Washington brings people, resources, and ideas together to strengthen Jewish life across our region. Strategic marketing helps connect people with Federation's mission, opportunities, and impact—inspiring them to participate, give, advocate, and deepen their relationship with our community.

The Director, Marketing Strategy leads Federation's marketing function, shaping how we reach, engage, and move audiences to action. This role leads integrated marketing strategy, audience engagement, digital marketing, media relations, and marketing performance—connecting organizational priorities with the audiences, channels, and approaches most likely to advance them.

Woking closely with the Chief Communications Officer, Director of Communications, and colleagues across Federation, the Director translates organizational priorities into focused marketing strategies, personally leads priority initiatives, and helps the team continuously improve how we understand and engage audiences.

This is an opportunity for an experienced marketing leader who enjoys both big picture thinking and making things happen. You'll lead strategy for Federation's most important marketing efforts, use data and audience insights to improve our approach, develop a talented team, experiment with new ideas, and help build a more sophisticated, integrated marketing capacity across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Integrated Marketing Strategy

Lead the strategy and planning of integrated marketing campaigns across Federation
Personally lead Federation's highest-priority and most complex marketing initiatives from strategy through implementation
Define campaign objectives, audiences, channels, sequencing, engagement, and conversion strategies
Develop audience strategies that connect people with relevant opportunities and move them toward deeper engagement with Federation
Translate organizational priorities into focused, actionable marketing plans and ensure they are carried through effectively
Guide integrated execution across email, website, social media, digital marketing, media relations, and other channels, stepping directly into priority initiatives where needed

Strengthen Audience Strategy, Measurement & Innovation

Set priorities and align team capacity and resources with Federation's highest-priority opportunities
Create clarity around priorities, responsibilities, and expectations so the team can operate proactively and effectively
Anticipate and address competing priorities, capacity constraints, and bottlenecks
Foster a collaborative culture grounded in strong judgment, accountability, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement

Success Looks Like

Federation's marketing is strategic, audience-centered, integrated, and focused on meaningful outcomes
Priority campaigns move effectively from strategy through implementation and inspire people to participate, give, advocate, and engage
Federation increasingly understands which audiences it is reaching, what moves them to engage, which marketing investments are working, and where to focus next
Marketing channels work together as part of an integrated strategy rather than operating independently
Audience insights, experimentation, and performance data routinely inform decisions and improve results over time
The Marketing team operates proactively and collaboratively, with clear priorities, strong judgment, and effective coordination

Experience using analytics, audience insights, and performance data to inform marketing decisions and improve results
Experience with audience segmentation, CRM or marketing technology, and data-informed customer or constituent engagement strategies
Exceptional strategic thinking, prioritization, planning, and organizational skills

Who We Are

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington, D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

What You'll Do

The Senior Associate, Communications and Marketing supports CATF's Communications and Marketing and Events teams through project coordination, content development, editorial support, media relations support, digital communications, and shared team systems. You'll help keep communications projects and resources organized while contributing to the content and tools CATF uses to communicate its work. This is a full-time, remote U.S.-based position with the flexibility to work from within the United States and the ability to work typical Eastern Time Zone business hours. Occasional travel is required.

The role is designed for a communications professional who wants to build broad experience while helping a global communications function work effectively.

Responsibilities

Project Coordination & Team Operations – Coordinate communications projects, meetings, shared resources, and tracking tools; prepare agendas; track action items; and help teams maintain clear and useful files and systems.
Editorial & Content Development – Draft, proofread, and edit select press releases, reports, blogs, newsletters, and other communications, working with communications managers to maintain consistent, accurate content.
Brand & Communications Standards – Maintain internal communications resources, including style guides, templates, brand guidelines, onboarding materials, and communications and marketing training resources.
Media Relations Support – Support media monitoring and reporting, maintain media lists and engagement records, and research relevant reporters and outlets in coordination with communications managers.
Digital Communications – Support social media marketing efforts and assist with maintaining website content and other digital communications as needed.
Cross-Team Collaboration – Work across Communications and Marketing, Events, and other teams to coordinate work, maintain shared resources, and support effective follow-through.

What You'll Bring

You're a strong writer and editor who can keep projects organized while working across several areas of communications. You're comfortable learning new systems, coordinating with colleagues in a remote environment, and taking ownership of the details that help work move forward. You bring sound judgment, strong collaboration skills, and an interest in CATF's mission.

Required Experience

Bachelor's degree.
3–5 years of experience in communications, marketing, or a related role.
Strong writing, editing, and organizational skills.
Experience with media monitoring and reporting analytics, media engagement, press list management, and customer relationship management tools such as MuckRack.
Digital fluency and knowledge of project management platforms.
Familiarity with website and social media content management and digital communications platforms.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively within and across teams.
Interest in and commitment to CATF's mission.

What We Provide

You'll contribute to how CATF communicates its work to accelerate climate solutions while supporting the systems and coordination that help its Communications and Marketing and Events teams operate effectively.

A mission-driven role supporting CATF's climate communications work.
Opportunities to collaborate across Communications and Marketing, Events, Development, and program teams.
A collaborative environment that brings together colleagues working across different areas of CATF.
A flexible remote working environment within the United States, with the ability to work typical U.S. East Coast hours.

Compensation & Pay Transparency

CATF believes candidates should have clear information about compensation and benefits so they can make informed decisions about opportunities with us. Our compensation ranges are based on the country of employment, and employees are paid in the applicable local currency. Any range listed below applies only to the country identified.

Base Salary

The Expected Base Salary Range For This Position Is

United States: $85,297–$102,356 USD annually

CATF does not consider an applicant's salary history when determining compensation.

Benefits

For U.S.-based employees, CATF offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial security, time away, and flexibility. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, with CATF currently paying 80% of medical premiums and 100% of dental premiums for eligible employees; a 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar employer match of up to 5% of gross annual salary; 25 working days of vacation per year for full-time employees; paid sick leave; U.S. holidays; and one flex day in December. CATF also provides employer-paid basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage, along with home-office setup support, a monthly internet stipend, and additional health, wellness, and voluntary benefit resources. Eligibility, coverage, costs, and plan terms are governed by applicable plan documents.

Ready to Apply?

If you've made it this far, you should go ahead and apply.

You don't need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role aligns with how you like to work and the kind of impact you want to have, we encourage you to submit your application.

Recently acquired by EAB, Hybrid is a globally recognized and award-winning agency that operates as a full-service marketing partner for the education sector, connecting universities with students worldwide. Powered by unrivaled insight, advanced technology, and AI-driven enrollment strategies, our integrated marketing solutions help education brands grow. We tackle the sector’s toughest challenges head-on and continuously strive for excellence, staying on the pulse of emerging trends. When you join our division of EAB, you become part of a tight-knit, ambitious, supportive, and rapidly growing team. You’ll work on big ideas with talented colleagues who respect your input, challenge your thinking and push you to do your best work. Visit our website to learn more about our story

The Role In Brief

Paid Media Executive, Hybrid

Hybrid is seeking a motivated, analytical, and results-driven Paid Media Executive to join our growing Digital team. In this role, you'll execute and optimize paid media campaigns for higher education clients around the world, helping institutions connect with prospective students through innovative, data-driven digital marketing strategies.

As a Paid Media Executive, you'll manage campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other digital advertising platforms while partnering with Account Managers, Digital Strategists, and clients to deliver measurable performance. You'll analyze campaign data, uncover actionable insights, and continuously optimize campaigns to maximize results across multiple channels.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their expertise in paid search, paid social, and emerging media platforms while working on global campaigns with significant budgets in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment.

This hire may be based in Philadelphia, PA, Richmond, VA, or Washington, D.C.

Primary Responsibilities

The Paid Media Executive is responsible for planning, launching, optimizing, and reporting on digital advertising campaigns that drive measurable results for Hybrid's higher education partners.

Campaign Management

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic platforms.
Execute campaign optimizations to improve performance and maximize return on advertising spend.
Monitor campaign pacing, budgets, and performance to ensure client objectives are achieved.
Support international campaigns across emerging media platforms as business needs evolve.

Performance Analysis & Optimization

Track campaign KPIs and analyze performance across multiple digital channels.
Develop insightful campaign reports that clearly communicate results and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
Identify performance trends, optimization opportunities, and emerging audience behaviors.
Utilize data to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and overall client outcomes.

Client Success & Collaboration

Build a strong understanding of each client's goals, enrollment objectives, and marketing strategy.
Partner closely with Account Managers and Digital leadership to develop integrated media strategies.
Collaborate with platform partners including Google and Meta to leverage best practices and new capabilities.
Contribute ideas that improve campaign performance, innovation, and client experience.

Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate campaign documentation, reporting, and time management.
Ensure projects are completed on schedule while managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Stay current on industry trends, platform updates, and emerging digital advertising technologies.
Continue developing expertise across new advertising channels and international media platforms.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.
1-3+ years of experience managing paid digital media campaigns, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
Experience working with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify actionable insights.
Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or similar reporting tools.
Self-motivated with a strong desire to continuously learn and improve.

Ideal Qualifications

Experience managing paid Search, Social, and Programmatic advertising campaigns.
Familiarity with campaign tracking, attribution, and digital marketing analytics.
Experience working with large advertising budgets across multiple clients.
Passion for digital marketing, emerging advertising technologies, and performance optimization.
Ability to think strategically while executing campaigns with precision.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally with client services and creative teams.
Experience working within an agency environment is preferred.

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $60,000 - $70,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

Benefits

Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution

Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel

Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance

added.title: Senior Developer Marketing Manager, Lifecycle & Growth
added.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Developer Relations team builds developer tooling and creates awareness through events, social channels, and community activity. In this hands-on role, you’ll turn that attention into active users by owning the journey from first touch through signup, installation, first success, and continued engagement, while also owning the Developer Hub as the main conversion surface. By helping more developers discover and adopt 1Password’s developer tooling, you’ll contribute to the company’s mission and growth.

How We’re Using AI Today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in developer marketing, lifecycle or customer relationship management (CRM) marketing, or growth marketing for a technical or developer-facing product.
Proven experience building lifecycle programs that improved activation and retention, with measurable results.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation and lifecycle tools such as Customer.io, HubSpot, Braze, or Iterable, as well as product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog.
Experience owning or substantially improving website conversion performance, including A/B testing.
Strong writing skills, with an instinct for what developers find useful and credible.
Comfort working with engineers and developer advocates and with technical concepts such as application programming interfaces (APIs), command-line interfaces (CLIs), software development kits (SDKs), and documentation. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be able to try the product yourself.
Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in a remote, async-friendly team. Preferred: Experience with product-led growth, free-to-paid conversion, open source adoption, event and community programs, Structured Query Language (SQL), Hypertext Markup Language (HTML), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), scripting, search engine optimization (SEO), docs-led growth, or developer communities such as GitHub, Discord, Reddit, Hacker News, X, or LinkedIn.

What You Can Expect

Build capture-to-activation flows for leads from conferences, meetups, hackathons, webinars, and social channels, including QR codes, event-specific landing pages, follow-up sequences, and starter kits.
Work with Developer Relations teammates so every event, talk, and social moment has a clear call to action, tracking, and post-event nurture plan.
Turn social engagement, including launches, threads, demos, and community moments, into measurable traffic and signups through the right landing pages and offers.
Design and run lifecycle programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, re-engagement, and expansion using email, in-product messaging, and community channels.
Define activation for the product, build programs around milestones such as a first application programming interface (API) call, successful build, or integration, and segment messaging by behavior, role, language, technology stack, and source.
Own the Developer Hub’s strategy, messaging, and conversion across its homepage, product pages, community pages, and events pages. Run continuous testing across copy, calls to action, page structure, and signup flows, and partner with Design, Engineering, and Documentation to improve time-to-first-value.
Write or direct tutorials, quickstarts, sample applications, changelogs, and email content; build reporting from first touch through activation and retention; and share findings that help shape the roadmap and messaging. Early success will include auditing the funnel, launching event follow-up and onboarding programs, and improving signup-to-activation, event-to-user, and Developer Hub conversion.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $133,000 USD and $186,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $125,000 CAD and $175,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Strong product marketing experience within consumer technology, healthcare, digital health, or related industries.

Demonstrated success growing adoption, engagement, retention, or expansion of consumer-facing products.
Strong market research, analytical, and strategic planning capabilities.
Ability to translate customer and market insights into actionable business strategies.

Consumer Focus: You consistently start with customer needs and use those insights to influence decisions and outcomes.
