added.title: Sr. Marketing Analytics Analyst
added.description:
The Role
Pilot is hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own our marketing analytics and uplevel our data-driven decision-making as we embark on the fastest-growing and quickest-evolving time in our company’s history.
Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. This year we announced our AI accounting platform, Meridian, and it has quickly become an industry leader because it was built with the nearly a decade of experience Pilot has building a platform for accountants and providing high quality accounting services. While this new product is exciting, it comes with a plethora of new complexity as we strive to grow our current back office services while also rapidly growing our AI platform clientele.
Marketing is the biggest single driver of our revenue and is our largest spend line. With Meridian, our marketing motion is rapidly changing: more events, more brand investment, and more channels. With this, attribution, tracking, and reporting get harder and harder but more and more important. We need someone experienced and knowledgeable in the domain to lead our analytics to where it needs to go.
As a Senior Data Analyst, you will work closely with the marketing team and company leadership to own marketing analytics across attribution, channel economics, experimentation, and incrementality. You will identify which channel dollars are paying off and how we should reallocate our budget to maximize revenue efficiency. Most importantly, you will own closing the gap between us being data-informed and having a data-driven marketing engine.
This is a strong fit for someone who strives to turn data and analytics into actionable insights and tangible impact, and who works with high-level leaders not just as a consumer of their data asks, but as a partner in finding the right data solutions.
Pilot’s data stack is Snowflake, dbt, and Looker, with Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce on the marketing side. We are active users of Claude Code to make our processes more efficient and our output more prolific.
Location: San Francisco, CA (3 days/week in office—Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays).

Key Responsibilities

Own attribution: make campaign-level multi-touch attribution usable and move marketers off Salesforce campaign influence reporting
Own channel efficiency at the top of the funnel: cost per lead, per SQL, and per pipeline dollar by channel and campaign group, and recommendations on where to allocate the next dollar
Design, run, and report on incrementality tests, including holdout and geo tests
Measure brand and event channels: podcast and conference sponsorships, advertorial, webinars, and brand spend. Group channels where a channel-by-channel read is not possible, and use observed lift where a controlled test is not available
Own marketing unit economics: LTV, CAC, and CAC payback by segment, cost to serve, and the ideal customer profile for our direct business
Build GTM analytics for our new product line as deal volume arrives: lead scoring, closed-lost analysis, and engagement depth
Support lifecycle and nurture marketing: measurement for a team that does not source its own leads, and driver analysis on re-engagement

What You'll Be Doing

The Marketing Associate supports Financial Advisors, branch associates, and home office partners within assigned regions by coordinating marketing requests and helping ensure work moves efficiently from intake through completion. The Marketing Associate works closely with the Marketing Specialist assigned to each region and with teams across Marketing to gather complete information, manage workflow activity, provide timely communication, and support the execution of marketing initiatives. This role serves as an accessible frontline resource for marketing questions and helps advisors and branch associates navigate Marketing processes, platforms, and available resources.

What We're Looking For

Serve as a frontline marketing contact for Financial Advisors, Client Service Associates, branch personnel, and home office partners, responding to questions and helping individuals navigate Marketing resources, processes, and platforms.
Review incoming marketing requests for completeness and accuracy, gather necessary information, and assign work to appropriate team members in accordance with established processes and priorities.
Monitor active requests and projects within assigned regions, identify potential delays or risks, and coordinate with internal teams to help ensure timely completion of work.
Provide proactive and timely communication regarding project status, open items, next steps, and anticipated timelines to advisors, branch associates, and internal stakeholders.
Educate advisors and branch associates on request submission best practices, approved marketing resources, self-service tools, and available marketing solutions.
Participate in regional meetings with Marketing Specialists, advisors, and branch personnel to understand business objectives, upcoming initiatives, and anticipated marketing needs, while documenting follow-up items and supporting execution.
Monitor activity within assigned regions and identify recurring questions, advisor needs, and trends, sharing relevant insights with the Marketing Specialist and team leadership.
Coordinate with Design, Writing, Compliance, Brand, Social Media, Video & Digital, and other Marketing teams to facilitate execution of advisor and branch marketing initiatives.
Maintain working knowledge of Marketing policies, brand standards, available resources, and industry regulations while participating in department initiatives and process improvement efforts.

What You'll Bring

Foundational knowledge of marketing, communications, project coordination, and customer service principles.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective working relationships.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify risks, gather information, and recommend solutions.
Ability to work collaboratively across teams and provide exceptional service to advisors and internal business partners.
Working knowledge of financial-services marketing regulations and requirements, or the ability to develop such knowledge.

Education & Experience

Minimum Required: B.S. or B.A. in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum Required: 1+ years of marketing, communications, customer service, account support, project coordination, or similar experience.

Licenses & Credentials

Minimum Required: None
